viewer: Hindi-speaking students and young adults, 15-30, scrolling a feed of dark horror reels
hook: The whole school's shadows are gone at noon. One wet footprint trail crosses the white courtyard.
payoff: For one minute the dead look like the living. Raju took the narrator's hand and the one shadow that returned: the narrator's stayed with Raju, who went home as him.
belief_label: Dadi's rule is an invented family saying, not a sourced regional tradition. Zero Shadow Day itself is a real astronomical event (sun at the zenith at local solar noon, twice a year south of 23.5 N, about one minute).
sources: Original story (Doomsday Horror). Code-drawn visuals, Kalpa Labs TTS (Aman), sound synthesized in code. No third-party footage, images or audio. Science background: https://www.scienceabc.com/eyeopeners/what-is-the-zero-shadow-day.html

story.setup: School courtyard on Zero Shadow Day. Dadi has warned the narrator not to hold anyone's hand; master ji makes everyone hold hands.

rule_or_clue.text: do not hold anyone's hand today
rule_or_clue.line: दादी ने कहा था, आज किसी का हाथ मत पकड़ना।

rule_or_clue.text: dead and living look alike for a minute, only one shadow returns
rule_or_clue.line: उस एक मिनट में ज़िंदा और मुर्दे में फ़र्क़ नहीं रहता, और परछाईं सिर्फ़ एक ही लौटती है।

rule_or_clue.text: Raju was alone at the well last year on this day and never came back
rule_or_clue.line: पिछले साल इसी दिन, राजू कुएँ पे अकेला था। वापस नहीं आया।

escalation.text: every shadow shrinks away, sound dies
escalation.line: फिर एक एक करके, सबकी परछाईं गायब हो गई।

escalation.text: a cold hand takes his in 40 degree heat
escalation.line: किसी ने मेरा हाथ पकड़ा। चालीस डिग्री में भी, हाथ ठंडा था।

escalation.text: it is Raju, wet hair, a drop on hot stone
escalation.line: वो राजू था। बाल गीले, बूँद टपकती हुई।

false_relief.text: shadows return, one appears under his feet, he breathes out
false_relief.line: परछाइयाँ लौटीं। मेरी भी। मैंने साँस ली।

twist.text: he lets go and his shadow stays joined to Raju's feet
twist.line: मैंने हाथ छुड़ाया। मेरी परछाईं राजू के पैरों से जुड़ी रही।
twist.how: The hook says every shadow was gone and the rule says dead and living look alike for a minute: Raju used that minute to take the one shadow that came back, so the boy who walks home is Raju and the narrator is the one left shadowless.

ending_image.text: bright empty courtyard, the narrator alone with his hand raised and no shadow; wet footprints evaporating at his feet

callback.text: wet footprints evaporating on hot stone, now at his own feet
callback.line: परछाईं गायब हो, तो किसी का हाथ मत पकड़ना।

story.scare_pattern: daylight swap: a dead friend takes your hand and your shadow
